logic.empty: No rules yet. Add a rule to show, hide or skip to a field depending on an answer.

fields.title: Add fields
fields.body: The panel on the left has every field type. Drag one onto your form to add it.

canvas.title: Your form
canvas.body: This is your form as respondents will see it. Click any field to edit it.

settings.title: Field settings
settings.body: Select a field and its settings open in the right-hand panel, with tabs for Field, Logic and Style.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Click the eye icon in the top bar to try your form before you share it.

publish.title: Ready?
publish.body: Hit the green Publish button in the top right corner when your form is ready to go live.

errors.publishNoFields: Add at least one field before you publish this form.
errors.domainNotFound: We could not find a CNAME record for this domain yet. DNS changes can take up to 48 hours.
